header.eyebrow: Chinese university scholarships for African students.
header.heading--main: Your scholarship in China starts here!
header.heading--sub: We guide you from application to enrollment: documents, university submissions, and visa support, with every step tracked online.

how-it-works.eyebrow: 5 clear steps from your form to your first day on campus.
how-it-works.heading: How it works
how-it-works.step__1--paragraph: Will in our online application form and upload your documents. You will get confirmation right away, and your personal tracker opens.
how-it-works.step__2--paragraph: Our team checks every documents. If something needs fixing, you will be notified exactly what and why, so nothing delays your application.
how-it-works.step__3--paragraph: Once your file is complete, we submit it to the university or scholarship council and follow up while they review it.
how-it-works.step__4--paragraph: Your are notified as soon as a decision arrives. If you are admitted, we help you get your offer or admission notice.
how-it-works.step__5--paragraph: We support you thorugh your visa application until your enrollment is confirmed and you are ready to travel.
how-it-works.tracker-callout: Know where you stand at every stage. Follow your application online, from "Application submitted" to "Enrollement confirmed"
